import BoundedQueue.Spec
namespace BoundedQueue

def step : Impl := fun s op =>
  match op with
  | .enqueue x =>
    if s.items.length < s.capacity then (.ok, { s with items := s.items ++ [x] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .dequeue =>
    match s.items with
    | [] => (.rejected, s)
    | x :: rest => (.got x, { s with items := rest, served := s.served + 1 })

theorem req_valid_succeeds  : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_capacity        : CapacityBound step := sorry
theorem req_enqueue_effects : EnqueueEffects step := sorry
theorem req_dequeue_effects : DequeueEffects step := sorry
theorem req_fifo            : Fifo step := sorry

end BoundedQueue

private theorem fifo_single_aux (s : State) (op : Op) :
    s.items ++ inflowOf (op, (step s op).1) =
    outflowOf (op, (step s op).1) ++ (step s op).2.items := by
  cases op with
  | enqueue x =>
    unfold step
    by_cases hlt : s.items.length < s.capacity
    · simp only [hlt, ↓reduceIte, inflowOf, outflowOf]
    · simp only [hlt, ↓reduceIte, inflowOf, outflowOf]
  | dequeue =>
    cases hitems : s.items with
    | nil =>
      have e : step s .dequeue = (.rejected, s) := by unfold step; simp [hitems]
      have h1 : (step s .dequeue).1 = .rejected := by rw [e]
      have h2 : (step s .dequeue).2 = s := by rw [e]
      rw [h1, h2]
      simp only [inflowOf, outflowOf, hitems, List.append_nil, List.nil_append]
    | cons x rest =>
      have e : step s .dequeue = (.got x, { s with items := rest, served := s.served + 1 }) := by
        unfold step; simp [hitems]
      have h1 : (step s .dequeue).1 = .got x := by rw [e]
      have h2 : (step s .dequeue).2.items = rest := by rw [e]; simp only
      rw [h1, h2]
      simp only [inflowOf, outflowOf]
      rw [hitems]
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]

theorem req_fifo : Fifo step := by
  intro s ops
  induction ops generalizing s with
  | nil =>
    simp only [Fifo] at *
    simp [run, inflow, outflow]
  | cons op ops IH =>
    have hsingle := fifo_single_aux s op
    have hIH := IH (step s op).2
    have hrun1 : (run step s (op :: ops)).1 =
        (op, (step s op).1) :: (run step (step s op).2 ops).1 := rfl
    have hrun2 : (run step s (op :: ops)).2 =
        (run step (step s op).2 ops).2 := rfl
    -- unfold inflow/outflow on cons
    have hin : inflow ((op, (step s op).1) :: (run step (step s op).2 ops).1) =
        inflowOf (op, (step s op).1) ++ inflow (run step (step s op).2 ops).1 := rfl
    have hout : outflow ((op, (step s op).1) :: (run step (step s op).2 ops).1) =
        outflowOf (op, (step s op).1) ++ outflow (run step (step s op).2 ops).1 := rfl
    rw [hrun1, hrun2, hin, hout]
    -- goal: s.items ++ (inflowOf ++ inflow') = (outflowOf ++ outflow') ++ final
    have h1 : s.items ++ (inflowOf (op, (step s op).1) ++ inflow (run step (step s op).2 ops).1) =
        (s.items ++ inflowOf (op, (step s op).1)) ++ inflow (run step (step s op).2 ops).1 := by
      simp only [List.append_assoc]
    have h2 : (outflowOf (op, (step s op).1) ++ outflow (run step (step s op).2 ops).1) ++
        (run step (step s op).2 ops).2.items =
        outflowOf (op, (step s op).1) ++
        (outflow (run step (step s op).2 ops).1 ++ (run step (step s op).2 ops).2.items) := by
      simp only [List.append_assoc]
    rw [h1, h2, hsingle, hIH]
